limitations: Regular single-row layout with uniform cell height, two body taps and explicit M2-M4 routing; these are achievable implementation areas, not minimum-area results.
Delay-area products combine measured physical area with existing pre-layout Spectre delay. They are screening comparisons, not extracted timing or a final grading result.
Only the 14 selected beta-grid points have physical area evidence; do not impute their areas to the remaining 58 points.
The physical layout boundary excludes testbench input drivers and external load capacitors.
